support_policy: 10.0.0 release with the frozen api-v1.4.0 contract on /api/v1. RD remains disabled by default; remote control payloads use direct UDP P2P only, with no relay or TURN fallback. New capabilities require matching 10.0.0 clients and signed host reports; existing 7.0 tunnels remain supported. Back up and test restore before deployment. Capabilities not covered by the attached acceptance evidence are unverified. FRP follows its separate upstream version.
